Hey there!
Finally, the Huge Update is LIVE NOW!

You will get:

 Difficulty levels. Believe me, you would want to try them out!
 New Enemies
 New behaviours for old enemies
 New Outfits (most are available only at hard and hardcore difficulties)
 More interactions in fight scenes
 New death scenes
 Sounds during h-scenes

 And everything i just can't remember XD


Merry X-mas and Happy New Year!
Enjoy!

notes.title: Checkpoint Update + localizations
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
I just wanted to tell you we have fixed the checkpoints!
Now you have two options:
[olist]
 Restart the current battle screen (as it was before)
 Load the checkpoint so you can save and grab some more gear!
[/olist]

And also i want to thank our players who helped to make a proper localizations to several languages:
[olist]
 Arabic - Ahmed Saad
 French - LeFrenchCat
 Bulgarian - Tremere
 German - BigDino
[/olist]
Thank you guys - you're da best!

Stay safe and have fun!
